pages.title: Seed Picking Unit
pages.text: The Seed Picking Unit extracts seeds from mature plants for continuous Planting Unit operation.$(br2)Power: 10 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item per 2 seconds$(br)Clearance: 5x5
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
